mixture.en: I think what makes Warsaw fascinating is that it has this mixture of histories.
mixture.zh: 我认为华沙最迷人的地方在于它融合了多种历史。

mixture.en: Through a mixture of political manipulation, blackmail, and dealmaking, he manages to become Vice President.
mixture.zh: 通过政治操纵、勒索和交易的组合拳，他成功当上了副总统。

mixture.en: Again, this mixture of secrecy and transparency has made it a prime target for conspiracy theories.
mixture.zh: 同样，这种神秘与透明并存的特质使其成为了阴谋论的主要目标。

mixture.en: It's often a very complex mixture of reasons.
mixture.zh: 这通常是各种原因非常复杂的混合体。

mixture.en: OK. So, a mixture of the implicit teaching of the apps and some explicit teaching – for example, learning grammar rules – is useful.
mixture.zh: 好的。因此，将应用的内隐教学与一些显性教学（例如学习语法规则）结合起来是有用的。

military.en: They were often recruited from Russian special forces or veterans of elite military units.
military.zh: 他们通常从俄罗斯特种部队或精锐军事单位的退伍军人中招募。

military.en: He trained his men in modern European military tactics rather than traditional Irish methods.
military.zh: 他用现代欧洲军事战术而非传统的爱尔兰方法训练部下。

military.en: Whether they feared arrest or were seeking military support from abroad, historians still debate.
military.zh: 历史学家们至今仍在争论他们是因为害怕被捕，还是为了在国外寻求军事支持。

military.en: The Council authorised military action to protect civilians during the civil war in Libya.
military.zh: 安理会曾授权采取军事行动在利比亚内战期间保护平民。

military.en: Oil paid for everything—the palaces, the welfare state, the military, the sprawling bureaucracy.
military.zh: 石油支付了一切费用——宫殿、福利国家、军队、庞大的官僚机构。

mile.en: It questioned why an island, Britain, thousands of miles away, should govern an entire continent.
mile.zh: 它质疑为什么一个远在数千英里之外的岛屿——英国，应该统治整整一个大陆。

mile.en: Professor Gunhild Sætren lives on the icy island of Svalbard, 800 miles inside the Arctic Circle.
mile.zh: Gunhild Sætren 教授住在冰天雪地的斯瓦尔巴群岛，这里位于北极圈内800英里处。

mile.en: The Netherlands' cycle network spreads over 95,000 miles, and there are more bikes in the country than its 18 million citizens.
mile.zh: 荷兰的自行车网络绵延超过9.5万英里，国内的自行车数量比其1800万公民还要多。

mile.en: An Exclusive Economic Zone is an area of ocean which extends up to 200 nautical miles from a country’s coast.
mile.zh: 专属经济区是指从一国海岸线延伸达200海里的海洋区域。

mile.en: A special court was set up in Salem Town, just a few miles away, to deal with the growing list of the accused.
mile.zh: 一个特别法庭在几英里外的塞勒姆镇设立，专门处理日益增多的被指控人员名单。

minimal.en: The idiom the bar is low means that the standards, expectations, or requirements are minimal and very easy to meet.
minimal.zh: 习语“标准很低”（the bar is low）意味着标准、期望或要求都很最低，非常容易满足。

minimal.en: The Austrian School of economics argues, essentially, that the most effective economic system is one based on free markets and voluntary exchange, with minimal government interference.
minimal.zh: 奥地利学派经济学实质上认为，最有效的经济体系是建立在自由市场和自愿交换基础上的体系，政府干预应降到最低。

minimal.en: Strategically, this mission made a lot of sense, and the British and French forces, two of the strongest military forces in the world, anticipated moving through the peninsula with minimal resistance.
minimal.zh: 从战略上讲，这项任务非常合乎逻辑，作为世界上最强大的两支军事力量，英法军队预计能够以最小的抵抗穿过半岛。

minimal.en: The example I can think of right now is, I always remember observing an American English teacher’s class where during a pronunciation lesson focusing on L-R minimal pairs, /l/, /r/ minimal pairs… river versus liver.
minimal.zh: 我现在能想到的例子是，我一直记得曾经观摩过一位美籍英语老师的课，当时是在上一堂专注于 L-R 最小对立体、/l/、/r/ 最小对立体的发音课……river（河流）与 liver（肝脏）。

minimal.en: The example I can think of right now is, I always remember observing an American English teacher’s class where during a pronunciation lesson focusing on L-R minimal pairs, /l/, /r/ minimal pairs… river versus liver.
minimal.zh: 我现在能想到的例子是，我一直记得曾经观摩过一位美籍英语老师的课，当时是在上一堂专注于 L-R 最小对立体、/l/、/r/ 最小对立体的发音课……river（河流）与 liver（肝脏）。

microwave.en: And again, with a ready meal, you put it in the microwave for a couple of minutes.
microwave.zh: 还有，买一份预制菜，你把它放进微波炉几分钟。

microwave.en: A ready meal is a meal from a supermarket that has already been prepared and can be heated up quickly in a microwave.
microwave.zh: 预制菜是指超市里已经准备好、可以在微波炉里快速加热的饭菜。

microwave.en: The post-war decades saw the growth of processed food and convenience food: frozen vegetables, canned food, instant meals, microwave meals.
microwave.zh: 战后的几十年见证了加工食品和便利食品的增长：冷冻蔬菜、罐头食品、即食食品、微波炉加热食品。

microwave.en: Now, to put that in perspective, the energy use is like one second of using a microwave, or 6 seconds of having your fridge on.
microwave.zh: 为了让你有个直观的概念，这耗能就像使用微波炉一秒钟，或者让冰箱运行 6 秒钟。

mild.en: Millions of investors lost money, and the US economy entered a mild recession.
mild.zh: 数百万投资者损失了金钱，美国经济进入了温和的衰退。

mild.en: I had what I presume to be Covid. But I've been alright since, mild snuffles aside.
mild.zh: 我得了我猜应该是新冠的病。不过之后除了有点轻微流鼻涕之外，我一直挺好的。

mild.en: When people imagine traditional British food, they picture boiled vegetables with potatoes and gravy and mild flavors.
mild.zh: 当人们想象传统的英国食物时，脑海中浮现的是水煮蔬菜配土豆、肉汁和清淡的味道。

mild.en: Tens of thousands—activists, bloggers, even students—were rounded up in a sweeping crackdown that made Mubarak’s repression look mild by comparison.
mild.zh: 数以万计的人——活动人士、博主、甚至学生——在一次大清洗中被捕，与此相比，Mubarak 的镇压显得温和多了。

mild.en: Mild or moderate acne is very common in teenagers and younger adults, so according to the UK’s National Health Service, what proportion of people aged 11 to 30 experience some amount of acne?
mild.zh: 轻度或中度痤疮在青少年和年轻成年人中非常普遍，那么根据英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）的数据，11岁到30岁的人群中有多少比例经历过某种程度的痤疮？

misunderstand.en: Another area where the meaning of words can be easily misunderstood is apologising.
misunderstand.zh: 另一个词义容易被误解的领域是道歉。

misunderstand.en: So let’s take a moment to clear up some of the most commonly misunderstood concepts.
misunderstand.zh: 因此，让我们花点时间来澄清一些最常被误解的概念。

misunderstand.en: There must surely have been a mixup, a misunderstanding, and he would be released soon.
misunderstand.zh: 这里面肯定是搞错了，是个误会，他很快就会被放出来。

misunderstand.en: This idea is important because a lot of people misunderstand confidence.
misunderstand.zh: 这个概念很重要，因为很多人对自信有误解。

misunderstand.en: It never misunderstands you in the way a real person does.
misunderstand.zh: 它绝不会像真实人物那样误解你。

minor.en: And finally, small wins are minor successes which contribute to a larger life goal.
minor.zh: 最后，“small wins”是微小的成功，它们有助于实现更大的生活目标。

minor.en: Snuffles is an informal word used to describe minor illnesses that affect your nose.
minor.zh: Snuffles是一个非正式词汇，用来描述影响鼻子的轻微疾病。

minor.en: Another nine were seriously injured, and the remaining eleven escaped with minor injuries.
minor.zh: 另有九人重伤，其余十一人受轻伤。

minor.en: The workhouse master was dismissed. There were some minor changes to the law.
minor.zh: 这名济贫院主管被解雇了。法律做了一些小幅修改。

minor.en: Snuffles, or sniffles, are minor illnesses that affect your nose.
minor.zh: Snuffles，或者sniffles，是影响你鼻子的轻微疾病。

mirror.en: I didn’t really know the vocabulary for terms like lanes or mirrors or traffic laws.
mirror.zh: 我真的不知道车道、后视镜或交通法规等术语怎么说。

mirror.en: At the beginning, driving is hard. You’re thinking about everything: mirrors, indicators, braking, steering, road signs.
mirror.zh: 一开始，开车很难。你要考虑所有事情：后视镜、转向灯、刹车、方向盘、道路标志。

mirror.en: Parts of cars like the “clutch”, “accelerators”,” indicators” and “mirrors”.
mirror.zh: 汽车零件，比如“离合器”、“油门”、“转向灯”和“后视镜”。

mirror.en: MyPolis mirrors the political activities that children will need as adult citizens – things like voting and holding politicians accountable.
mirror.zh: MyPolis模拟了孩子们作为成年公民所需要的政治活动——比如投票和监督政客。

mirror.en: A lot of the writing is backwards. He had a habit of writing in mirror script, which means writing backwards.
mirror.zh: 很多字都是反着写的。他有一种用镜书习惯，也就是倒着写。

microscope.en: Mathematicians don’t look through telescopes or use microscopes.
microscope.zh: 数学家不通过望远镜或使用显微镜观察。

microscope.en: The phrase to the naked eye means in a way that can be seen without special instruments, like a microscope, or is seen in the way an ordinary person would.
microscope.zh: “用肉眼”这个短语的意思是，不用显微镜等特殊仪器，或者以普通人的方式就能看到。

migrate.en: OK. Let's recap the vocabulary we've learned, starting with migrate: move to a different place.
migrate.zh: 好，我们来回顾一下学到的词汇，先从 migrate(迁徙)开始：指转移到另一个地方。

migrate.en: Yes. In fact, lots of species that migrate are really important for fighting climate change.
migrate.zh: 没错。事实上，很多迁徙物种对于对抗气候变化都非常重要。

migrate.en: Around the 14th century, the Aztecs migrated into the Valley of Mexico.
migrate.zh: 大约在14世纪，阿兹特克人迁徙到了墨西哥谷。

migrate.en: Add to this an increasing number of people, both domestically and internationally, migrating into cities, and you have even more pressure on the housing supply.
migrate.zh: 再加上国内和国际上有越来越多的民众向城市迁移，这给住房供应带来了更大的压力。

migrate.en: Under the new UK plans, for example, refugees might face a longer path to permanent settlement even though they didn’t always choose to migrate for economic reasons.
migrate.zh: 例如，在英国的新计划下，难民可能会面临更长的永久定居之路，尽管他们迁移并非总是出于经济原因。

minister.en: He’s a very lawyer-like prime minister. Burnham is seen as warmer and more emotional.
minister.zh: 他是一位非常具有律师风格的首相。而Burnham则被认为更温暖、更有情绪感染力。

minister.en: Number 10 Downing Street is the traditional home of the prime ministers in Central London.
minister.zh: 唐宁街10号是伦敦市中心首相的传统住所。

minister.en: The PAP won the 1959 election, and Lee Kuan Yew became Singapore’s first prime minister.
minister.zh: 人民行动党赢得了1959年的选举，李光耀成为新加坡第一任总理。

minister.en: Then, in the late 1970s, Britain got a new Prime Minister: Margaret Thatcher.
minister.zh: 随后在20世纪70年代末，英国迎来了一位新首相：Margaret Thatcher。

minister.en: A minister stated that the government would in fact "completely rule out " re-introducing blasphemy laws.
minister.zh: 一位大臣表示，政府事实上将“完全排除”重新引入亵渎法的可能性。

misfortune.en: And finally, the idiom, the bane of my life refers to a source of persistent unhappiness or misfortune.
misfortune.zh: 最后，“我生命中的大患（the bane of my life）”这个习语指的是持续痛苦或不幸的根源。

misfortune.en: Dr Crichlow calls acne, the bane of my life, an idiom meaning the cause of unhappiness or misfortune.
misfortune.zh: Crichlow医生把痤疮称为我生命中的大患（the bane of my life），这是一个习语，意思是带来不幸或痛苦的根源。

misfortune.en: But why were they so afraid? Why did this small, God-fearing community see the devil behind every misfortune?
misfortune.zh: 但他们为什么会如此恐惧？为什么这个小小的、敬畏上帝的社群会在每一次不幸背后都看到魔鬼的影子？

mistress.en: He was also unlike most other kings. While many European monarchs were flamboyant, extravagant, obsessed with courts and ceremony and mistresses, George was frugal and hardworking.
mistress.zh: 他也跟大多数其他国王不同。许多欧洲君主生活奢靡、铺张浪费，痴迷于宫廷礼仪和情妇，而 George 则节俭且勤奋。

miracle.en: False claims about vaccines, miracle cures, government conspiracies, and the origins of the virus circulated everywhere.
miracle.zh: 关于疫苗、奇迹疗法、政府阴谋以及病毒来源的虚假声明到处流传。

miracle.en: The transformation is sometimes described as the Singapore economic miracle.
miracle.zh: 这种蜕变有时被描述为“新加坡经济奇迹”。

miracle.en: In many ways, it's a miracle that something that’s now so fundamental to our lives has such a tiny environmental impact.
miracle.zh: 从很多方面来看，一个对我们的生活如此基础的事物却对环境产生如此微小的影响，简直是一个奇迹。

miracle.en: The name means "miracle" in Afrikaans. This cave contains up to 7 metres of sediment, deposits, layers that had built up, millimetre by millimetre, over hundreds of thousands of years.
miracle.zh: 这个名字在南非语中是“奇迹”的意思。这个洞穴包含长达 7 米的沉积物，这些堆积物和地层历经几十万年，一毫米一毫米地累积起来。

millimetre.en: The name means "miracle" in Afrikaans. This cave contains up to 7 metres of sediment, deposits, layers that had built up, millimetre by millimetre, over hundreds of thousands of years.
millimetre.zh: 这个名字在南非语中是“奇迹”的意思。这个洞穴包含长达 7 米的沉积物，这些堆积物和地层历经几十万年，一毫米一毫米地累积起来。

millimetre.en: The name means "miracle" in Afrikaans. This cave contains up to 7 metres of sediment, deposits, layers that had built up, millimetre by millimetre, over hundreds of thousands of years.
millimetre.zh: 这个名字在南非语中是“奇迹”的意思。这个洞穴包含长达 7 米的沉积物，这些堆积物和地层历经几十万年，一毫米一毫米地累积起来。

miner.en: The spectre of industrial action loomed large, with miners’ strikes crippling the nation and leading to the implementation of the three-day working week in an attempt to conserve electricity.
miner.zh: 罢工潮的阴影笼罩着全国，矿工罢工使国家陷入瘫痪，为了节约用电，政府甚至实施了每周三天工作制。

miner.en: Now, Ohio State is a well-rated public university, but his next step would be into a world as foreign to him as the world of the Lancashire miners was to a doctor from Bristol: he was accepted into Yale Law School.
miner.zh: 如今，俄亥俄州立大学是一所评价不错的公立大学，但他接下来的跨越，对于他来说，就像兰开夏郡的矿工对于布里斯托尔的医生一样陌生：他被耶鲁法学院（Yale Law School）录取了。

miner.en: In this episode, part one, it’ll be Wyatt Earp: a man who, to quote his Wikipedia page, was at various points a Lawman, a buffalo hunter, a saloon keeper, a miner, a brothel keeper, and a boxing referee, which is a kind of resume you just don’t see nowadays.
miner.zh: 在这一集，也就是第一部分，主角是 Wyatt Earp：用他维基百科页面上的话说，他先后当过执法官、猎捕野牛的猎人、酒馆老板、矿工、妓院老板，还做过拳击裁判——这样的履历放在今天可是见不到了。

miner.en: There was a large battle between Thatcher and the coal miners, and eventually, after almost a year of strikes, Thatcher won, and then embarked on a series of privatisation measures, shutting down unprofitable mines and factories and selling off everything from railroads to utility companies to private investors.
miner.zh: Thatcher 与煤矿工人展开了一场激烈的较量，最终在经历近一年的罢工后，Thatcher 获胜，随后推行了一系列私有化措施，关闭了亏损的矿山和工厂，并将从铁路到公用事业公司的所有资产出售给私人投资者。

miniature.en: He lowers the voting age to fourteen. He is a big fan of Chairman Mao, and this is his version of Mao's Red Guards, a cultural revolution in miniature, on three small volcanic islands in the Indian Ocean.
miniature.zh: 他把投票年龄降到了十四岁。他是毛主席的崇拜者，而这就是他版本的“红卫兵”——在印度洋的三个小火山岛上上演的微缩版“文化大革命”。

mission.en: And when the war ended, he wasted no time returning to his life’s mission.
mission.zh: 战争一结束，他便毫不耽搁地回到了自己一生的使命中。

mission.en: For Fawcett this was a temporary setback, and he soon started planning another mission.
mission.zh: 对 Fawcett 来说，这只是暂时的挫折，他很快就开始筹划另一次任务。

mission.en: And it isn’t on a space mining mission, but rather a fact-gathering one.
mission.zh: 而且这不是一次太空采矿任务，而是一次收集信息的任务。

mission.en: And it was during one of these missions that Lawrence experienced the darkest moment of his life.
mission.zh: 正是在其中一次任务中，Lawrence 经历了人生中最黑暗的时刻。

mission.en: During a security mission, Blackwater guards opened fire on a crowded intersection, killing 17 Iraqi civilians and injuring many more.
mission.zh: 在一次安保任务中，黑水公司的警卫向一个拥挤的十字路口开枪，造成17名伊拉克平民死亡，多人受伤。

ministry.en: Ponting is a senior civil servant at the Ministry of Defence.
ministry.zh: 庞廷是英国国防部的一名高级公务员。

ministry.en: Government ministries, military planners, and industrial leaders all worked together to coordinate their war efforts from Berlin.
ministry.zh: 政府部门、军事规划者和工业领袖都在柏林共同协调他们的战争努力。

ministry.en: Berlin was the center of Nazi power. Government ministries and party headquarters and different security organizations, were all based in the city.
ministry.zh: 柏林是纳粹权力的中心。政府部门、党总部和不同的安全组织都设在该市。

misery.en: Or failing that, you might post it in a forum somewhere and wait, hoping for a kind soul to put you out of your misery.
misery.zh: 或者如果不行，你可能会把它发到某个论坛上等待，希望有好心人能把你从痛苦中解救出来。

minority.en: However, the Voting Rights Act of 1965 still puts limits on reducing the voting power of minority groups, and there are lots of ongoing legal cases about this.
minority.zh: 然而，1965年的《选举权法》仍然对削弱少数群体投票权的行为进行了限制，并且有许多关于此事的未决法律诉讼。

minority.en: It can make elections less competitive and reduce the influence of groups of voters, especially minority voters, even if they make up a significant part of the population.
minority.zh: 这会降低选举的竞争激烈程度，并削弱特定选民群体（尤其是少数族裔选民）的影响力，即使他们占了人口相当大的比例。

minority.en: And today, well, dog ownership is huge. Sure, there are still some countries and societies where dogs are not popular, whether that’s for religious or societal reasons, but these are a minority.
minority.zh: 而如今，养狗规模极为庞大。当然，仍然有一些国家和地区的人不怎么养狗，无论是出于宗教还是社会原因，但这毕竟是少数。

minority.en: Now, although by the 14th century or so, universities were well-established, and there were around 50 scattered across Europe, they still only educated an extreme minority of the population, so we’re probably talking about fewer than 50,000 students at every university in total.
minority.zh: 现在，尽管到了 14 世纪左右，大学已经相当成熟，欧洲各地散落着大约 50 所大学，但它们仍然只教育了极少数的人口，所以我们可能在讨论所有大学总共不到 50,000 名学生。

mislead.en: And euphemisms can also be used to manipulate you, mislead you, or soften reality.
mislead.zh: 但委婉语也可以用来操纵你、误导你或粉饰现实。

mislead.en: Some economists argue that the phrase resource curse is misleading.
mislead.zh: 一些经济学家认为，“资源诅咒”这个词具有误导性。

mislead.en: This was empowering, but it also created a world where truthful, misleading, and completely false information existed side by side.
mislead.zh: 这赋予了人们力量，但同时也创造了一个真实信息、误导性信息以及完全虚假的信息并存的世界。

mislead.en: For example, after the Security Council approved action in Libya, Russia and China felt like they had been misled by the US.
mislead.zh: 例如，在安理会批准对利比亚采取行动后，俄罗斯和中国觉得他们被美国误导了。

mislead.en: Economists and statistics experts repeatedly proved that the number was misleading and wrong, but the emotional impact of the claim had already taken hold.
mislead.zh: 经济学家和统计专家多次证明这个数字具有误导性且是错误的，但该主张带来的情感冲击已经扎根。

millionaire.en: There are plenty of counter-examples to this, of self-made millionaires who dropped out of school and carved their own path to success, but these are anomalies, in the UK at least.
millionaire.zh: 对此有大量的反例，比如辍学并开辟自己成功之路的白手起家的百万富翁，但这些只是反常现象，至少在英国是这样。

microphone.en: When I thought they were good enough, I recorded them using a microphone I borrowed from a friend.
microphone.zh: 当我觉得写得差不多了，我就用从朋友那里借来的麦克风录音。

microphone.en: The prisoners followed the guards’ instructions, the guards kept watch, and Zimbardo and his team observed everything from behind hidden cameras and microphones.
microphone.zh: 囚犯们听从狱警的指示，狱警负责看守，Zimbardo 和他的团队则通过隐藏的摄像头和麦克风观察着一切。

migrant.en: They welcomed Europeans fleeing war torn countries, and later migrants from Asia and the Pacific.
migrant.zh: 他们欢迎逃离战火国家的欧洲人，后来又迎来了来自亚洲和太平洋地区的移民。

migrant.en: For many migrants, ILR has always been the main long-term goal.
migrant.zh: 对许多移民来说，ILR 一直是主要的长期目标。

migrant.en: Low living costs and large open spaces attracted artists and musicians, migrants from around the world.
migrant.zh: 低廉的生活成本和宽敞的开放空间吸引了来自世界各地的艺术家、音乐家和移民。

migrant.en: Its economy increasingly depends on migrant labour to keep key sectors running, everything from agriculture to elderly care to logistics.
migrant.zh: 其经济越来越依赖外来劳动力来维持关键部门的运转，从农业到老年护理再到物流，无所不包。

migrant.en: Christmas Island has been home to exploited migrant workers, brutal colonial mining operations, Japanese wartime occupation, and, more recently, Australia’s controversial refugee detention centre.
migrant.zh: 圣诞岛曾是遭到剥削的异国劳工、残酷的殖民采矿作业、日本战时占领地，以及更近期的、澳大利亚备受争议的难民拘留中心的所在地。

minimum.en: Another argument in favour of the minimum wage is that it increases consumer spending.
minimum.zh: 另一个支持最低工资的论点是它能增加消费支出。

minimum.en: It is a minimum across the world. It is not a comfortable standard of living.
minimum.zh: 它是全球的最低标准。它并非一个舒适的生活标准。

minimum.en: The first result read “Britain’s Minimum Wage Law Has Been an Abject Failure”.
minimum.zh: 第一个结果写着“英国的最低工资法是一次惨痛的失败”。

minimum.en: So it’s not the maximum or the minimum, but the point from which everything else is measured.
minimum.zh: 所以它既不是上限也不是下限，而是衡量其他一切的标准起点。

minimum.en: Policies like minimum wages and labor protections can also help ensure that people are not trapped in low paid insecure jobs.
minimum.zh: 诸如最低工资和劳动保护等政策也有助于确保人们不会陷入低薪、不稳定的工作。

mighty.en: At this point, in the late third century BCE, it wasn’t yet the mighty empire you’re probably picturing.
mighty.zh: 在公元前三世纪后期，它还不是你脑海中想象的那个强大帝国。

mingle.en: Soldiers and demonstrators mingled, and some soldiers even showed solidarity with the people.
mingle.zh: 士兵和示威者混在一起，一些士兵甚至对人民表现出了声援。

mist.en: It’s high in the mountains, surrounded by green peaks and often covered in mist.
mist.zh: 它高耸于群山之中，被青翠的山峰环绕，经常笼罩在薄雾之中。

mist.en: Some even had perfume fountains at their extravagant banquets, spraying scented mist over their guests.
mist.zh: 有些人甚至在他们奢侈的宴会上设置了香水喷泉，向客人们喷洒带香味的雾气。

minus.en: Temperatures dropped to minus 40 degrees Celsius.
minus.zh: 气温骤降至零下40摄氏度。

miserable.en: Dogs, cats and rats were killed to supplement the miserable 125 grammes of bread a day that each resident was allocated.
miserable.zh: 狗、猫和老鼠都被杀来吃，以勉强维持每人每天仅有125克面包的可怜配给。

mill.en: And particularly so in the north of the country, which had better access to natural resources, better rivers to power the mills and later transport goods, and better access to ports.
mill.zh: 在英国北部尤其如此，那里更容易获取自然资源，拥有更好的河流来为工厂提供动力并在日后运输货物，而且更便于通往港口。

mint.en: The UK grows lots of delicious herbs, mint and rosemary and thyme, we use a lot of that in our cooking.
mint.zh: 英国种植了许多美味的草本植物，如薄荷、迷迭香和百里香，我们在烹饪中经常使用它们。

missing.en: One thing that was missing from my list of accomplishments was getting my driving license.
missing.zh: 我的成就清单上漏掉的一件事就是拿到驾照。

missing.en: Bubbles are driven by excitement, speculation, and sometimes the fear of missing out.
missing.zh: 泡沫是由兴奋、投机以及有时对错失恐惧的心理驱动的。

missing.en: Enormous amounts of money can go missing through embezzlement or other corrupt practices.
missing.zh: 巨额资金会通过挪用公款或其他腐败行径凭空消失。

missing.en: This feeling is now commonly called FOMO, the Fear Of Missing Out.
missing.zh: 这种感觉现在通常被称为FOMO，即“错失恐惧症”。

missing.en: But I think they were also missing something important: a country and a civilisation are not the same thing.
missing.zh: 但我认为他们也忽略了一个重要的问题：国家和文明并不是一回事。

midnight.en: To make matters worse, the Germans changed the settings every single night at midnight.
midnight.zh: 更糟糕的是，德国人每天午夜都会准时更改设置。

missile.en: Missiles are launched at dawn. Borders are crossed at night and the world wakes up to another war that no one wanted.
missile.zh: 导弹在黎明时分发射。边境在夜间被跨越，世界在又一场无人想要的战争中醒来。
